propositions: Inbound link ADD failures that are deterministic (closed source, redundant ancestry, cycle) are re-emitted and re-attempted identically every pass, forming a permanent error floor of 19+ warnings/hour that never converges
The applier logs warn-and-continue for each failed write without recording the outcome, so the applier has no memory of previous attempts and re-derives the same impossible set each pass

A durable store of impossible links keyed by source|target|relation with a digest over the structural inputs that decided the failure would skip attempted writes in steady state until the inputs change

The deciding digest must cover the parent chain and transitive graph context (not just endpoints) to catch hierarchy redirects and cycle-breaking structural changes that invalidate previously-impossible links
The impossible links record must be committed to the tickets branch alongside the binding store so the skip survives between CI passes and takes effect in production
Corrupt or uncomputable records degrade to retry-next-pass (fail-open), and non-permanent errors are never recorded, preserving existing retry behavior for transient faults
